source.author: verg
source.text: Tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus Aether coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis magnus alit magno commixtus corpore fetus.
source.text_original: Tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus Aether / coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis / magnus alit magno commixtus corpore fetus.
source.text_english: Then the all-powerful Father Aether descends with fruitful showers into the bosom of his joyful consort, and, mingled in one great body, nourishes all the life-giving offspring.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Priscillianus in Hispania pars Manichei, de turpitudine cuius te discipuli diligunt plurimum uerbum perfectionis et scientiae sibi temere uindicantes; soli cum solis clauduntur mulierculis et illud eis inter coitum amplexusque decantant: tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus aether coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis magnus alit magno commixtus corpore fetus.
reuse.text_original: Priscillianus in Hispania pars Manichei, de turpitudine cuius te discipuli diligunt plurimum uerbum perfectionis et scientiae sibi temere uindicantes; soli cum solis clauduntur mulierculis et illud eis inter coitum amplexusque decantant: tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus aether coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis magnus alit magno commixtus corpore fetus.
reuse.text_english: Priscillian in Spain, a part of the Manichees, whose disciples love your disgrace most dearly, rashly claiming for themselves the title of perfection and knowledge: they shut themselves up alone with women, and amid intercourse and embraces they chant this to them: then the almighty father, the ether, descends in fruitful rains into the bosom of his glad spouse, and the great whole nourishes every great offspring, mingled in one body.
